calib_step_wheel_center: Click the CENTER of the color wheel
calib_step_wheel_rim: Click the wheel rim where RED is
calib_step_wheel_bright: Click the BRIGHT end of the brightness slider
calib_step_wheel_dark: Click the DARK end of the brightness slider
calib_step_hue_start: Click the START of the hue (rainbow) slider
calib_step_hue_end: Click the END of the hue (rainbow) slider
calib_step_box_tl: Click the TOP-LEFT corner of the color box
calib_step_box_br: Click the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner of the color box
status_error_no_picker_setup: Color picker is not set up yet. Open the Color Picker settings, choose a picker type, then click Calibrate (or press F5 while AutoDraw is open). Drawing was stopped.
drop_hint: Drop an image here, or use Import or Paste.
region_hint: Drag to select a region. Press Esc to cancel.
status_import_failed: Could not load {filename} as an image.
status_drop_invalid: Drop or paste a supported image file.
status_region_not_replaced: Region updated. The source image is not replaced while drawing is paused.
status_region_failed: Screen capture failed for the selected monitor.
status_monitor_missing: The selected monitor is not connected; using display {index}.
status_image_larger_than_region: Image is larger than the drawing area; use the resize controls to fit it.
hotkey_hint: F1 Capture region  |  F2 Start/Pause  |  F3 Stop  |  F4 Reset  |  F6 Quantize
check_recreate_mode: Use colour-layer recreate engine (instead of luminance trace)
hint_recreate_mode: When enabled, AutoDraw quantizes the image into one mask per colour and draws each layer with the selected picker. The legacy luminance trace is untouched while disabled.
hint_recreate_stroke_order: Serpentine is fastest; nearest-run reduces travel between disconnected areas.
status_recreate_verify_missing: Colour verification needs a calibrated current-colour indicator. Calibrate it in Settings or disable verification.
calib_step_recreate_current: Click the target application's current-colour indicator (the swatch showing the selected colour).
picker_status_unknown: Color Picker: unknown (press F5 to set up)
calib_rejected_body:
That calibration cannot be used: {reason}

The previous calibration is unchanged. Run Calibrate again and click the points more carefully.
calib_rejected_unknown: the picker rejected it for an unknown reason
calib_saved_wheel: Wheel calibrated. Colours are selected by clicking the hue/saturation disc and the brightness slider.
calib_saved_box: Color box calibrated. Colours are selected by clicking the hue strip and the saturation/value area.
calib_saved_current: Current-colour indicator saved. The engine verifies every selected colour against this pixel.
check_recreate_focus_guard: Stop safely if the target window loses focus
check_recreate_resume: Resume from the last checkpoint when the run matches
hint_recreate_safety: The mouse is released if the run is stopped, focus is lost, or an input step fails. A matching checkpoint lets the next run continue where the last one stopped.
hint_palette_space: Palette reduction uses this colour space. CIELAB matches perceived colour differences best; RGB is fastest.
status_recreate_resume_found: Found a checkpoint at stroke {stroke}; the run will resume.
status_recreate_focus_lost: The target window lost focus. The draw stopped and the mouse was released; run again to resume.
status_recreate_focus_arm_failed: No target window had focus when the draw started, so nothing was clicked. Focus the game first.
